[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-bd[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Idempotent bead close-and-publish, then repair the projection[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Closing an already-closed bead is a verified no-op that writes no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]event, no commit and no changed byte; a second close that arrives [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]anyway cannot move a close timestamp or erase a close reason; [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]concurrent note appends converge instead of overwriting each other;[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and the 313 bead rows already damaged by past duplicate closes are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]repaired by re-deriving `issues.jsonl` from the canonical event log[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rather than by rewriting history.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bead_close_integrity.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]202607/prompts/bead_close_integrity.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-bd[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-bd/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Closed-interval semantics in the event reducer[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-close-interval[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-close-interval: make `apply_event` treat a close of an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]already-closed bead as an exact no-op and clear [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`closed_at`/`close_reason` on every transition out of closed, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicate close events cannot move a close timestamp and the projection [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]converges regardless of merge order.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verified idempotent close in the mutation layer[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-close-verified[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-close-interval[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-close-verified: preflight every requested ID into closed / [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]already-closed / conflicting, abort the whole batch before any write [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]when an explicit resolution or reason disagrees with the recorded close,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and report the classification through new outcome-wire fields.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A convergent note_appended event[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-note-append[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-close-verified[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-note-append: add a `note_appended` event whose payload carries only[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the entry text, move note rendering into the reducer so appends compose [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of replacing, keep legacy whole-string note events working [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unchanged, and turn an unknown event kind into an actionable error.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]An honest sase bead close command[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli-close[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-close-verified[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli-close: stop printing "Closed" for beads that were already closed, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]distinguish cascade closes from requested ones, make the auto-commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]message name what actually happened, and stop the default resolution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from manufacturing a conflict on every commit-hook close.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Projection drift detection and repair[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]doctor-projection[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-close-interval[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]doctor-projection: teach doctor to compare `issues.jsonl` against the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reduction of the canonical streams, census redundant close events with a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recent-window rate, and add a guarded `--fix-projection` repair that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuses any diff outside the expected shape.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Redundant closes and restores in history[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]history-notes[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-close-interval[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]history-notes: label close events the reducer treated as redundant so a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timeline reads honestly, and add a non-interactive confirmation flag so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lost-note restoration can be run under an approval gate.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Core floor bump, docs, and full check[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]floor-docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-note-append, cli-close, doctor-projection, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]history-notes[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]floor-docs: raise the published sase-core-rs window to the release [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]containing the reducer and event changes, document the close idempotency[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract and the projection repair, refresh the beads skill source, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run the full check.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repair the live store under an approval gate[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after floor-docs[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]repair: run the guarded projection repair against the live beads [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar, verify the diff shape mechanically before committing, then [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restore the lost note revisions the research report deferred until the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]write path was safe.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
